git add -A && git -c user.email=redacted@example.invalid -c user.name=nosey-dewdrop commit -q -m "soz: observer voice from a shipped phrasebook, archetype label, no runtime model call

the copy was correct and flat. 'reply time went from 7 minutes to 4,1 hours' is true and gives
nobody chills, which is the whole point of the reference product.

the sentences are now written once and shipped as data in web/js/soz.js, with the engine injecting
every value. no model call at run time, no network call in this path at all. two measured reasons:
groq's free tier is 100k tokens a day, so even sending only derived facts (~600 tokens) caps at
about 160 analyses a day and the first viral hour returns 429 to everyone; and a model handed the
numbers invents numbers, which is exactly what the live spiker did when it quoted lines that were
never in the chat. here a wrong figure is impossible by construction.

- variants picked deterministically from the file's own seed, so one export always reads the same
- archetype label (bekleten, kuru cevap, tek tarafli, kaybolan, gece hatti, dengeli) computed from
  counts, each one printing the number behind it. this was in PROJECT.md m38 and had never been built
- archetypes name both people instead of saying 'sen'. this flow never asks which side the reader
  is, `me` is just whoever wrote most, so second person was a guess presented as a fact
- the same fact was printed with two different figures on one screen, 11,2x in the archetype and
  10,4x in the details, because one used a raw median ratio and the other the log2 asymmetry. one
  source now, and a test fails the build if two different 'kat' values ever appear together

gates: parse 25/25, timeline 16/16, cpd 9/9, e2e 6/6, yazi 10/10" && git push -q origin main && git branch -D t 2>/dev/null; git subtree split --prefix web -b t >/dev/null 2>&1 && git push -f -q origin t:gh-pages && git branch -D t >/dev/null && echo "MAIN + GH-PAGES OK"
